CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_room_start_notification_binding(e notification_activity_events)
 RETURNS private.room_start_notification_bindings
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select b from private.room_start_notification_bindings b join public.watch_party_rooms r on r.party_id=b.party_id
  where b.event_id=e.id and r.is_active and r.room_generation=b.room_generation and r.host_user_id=b.host_user_id
    and b.host_user_id=e.actor_user_id and b.recipient_user_id=e.recipient_user_id and b.source_id=e.source_id
    and b.event_kind=e.event_kind and b.source_type=e.context->>'sourceType'
    and b.source_revision=e.context->>'revision' and b.source_audience=e.context->>'audience';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.defer_duplicate_room_start(e notification_activity_events, p_state text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.notification_activity_events set status=case when p_state='pending' then 'pending' else 'suppressed' end,
    scheduled_at=case when p_state='pending' then now()+interval '5 seconds' else scheduled_at end,
    completed_at=case when p_state='pending' then null else now() end,lease_token=null,lease_until=null
    where id=e.id and status='leased' and lease_token=e.lease_token and lease_until>now();
  return jsonb_build_object('eligible',false,'reason',case when p_state='pending' then 'room_start_delivery_pending' else 'room_start_already_delivered' end);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.discovery_notification_event_revision(e creator_events)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select md5(jsonb_build_array(e.host_user_id,e.event_title,e.event_type,e.visibility,e.status,
    e.starts_at,e.ends_at,e.reminder_ready,e.time_zone,e.management_status,e.status_message)::text);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.discovery_notification_uuid(p_value text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin return nullif(btrim(p_value),'')::uuid;
exception when invalid_text_representation then return null; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.discovery_notification_video_public(v videos)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select v.visibility='public' and v.moderation_status in ('clean','reported')
    and public.media_scan_public_safe(v.scan_status) and v.quarantined_at is null
    and not coalesce(v.vip_access_required,false)
    and public.is_creator_video_playable_source(v.storage_path,v.storage_object_key,v.playback_url)
    and not coalesce((select p.is_paid from public.creator_content_prices p
      where p.content_type='creator_video' and p.content_id=v.id and p.creator_id=v.owner_id
      order by p.updated_at desc,p.id desc limit 1),false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.enqueue_discovery_notification_source(p_type text, p_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare s jsonb:=private.discovery_notification_source(p_type,p_id); owner_id uuid; who record; kind text;
begin
  if not coalesce((s->>'eligible')::boolean,false) then return; end if;
  owner_id:=private.discovery_notification_uuid(s->>'owner');
  for who in with candidates as (
    select f.follower_user_id as user_id from public.channel_followers f
      where s->>'audience'='public' and f.channel_user_id=owner_id::text
    union
    select case when f.user_low_id=owner_id::text then f.user_high_id else f.user_low_id end
      from public.user_friendships f where f.status='active'
        and (f.user_low_id=owner_id::text or f.user_high_id=owner_id::text)
        and (p_type in ('live_stage','broadcast') or s->>'audience'='circle')
  )
    select u.id,public.is_active_chilly_circle_member(owner_id::text,u.id::text) as friend
    from candidates c join auth.users u on u.id=private.discovery_notification_uuid(c.user_id)
    where u.id<>owner_id
  loop
    kind:=case when p_type='video' then 'public_upload' when p_type='replay' then 'replay_later'
      when who.friend then 'circle_friend_live' else 'followed_creator_live' end;
    perform private.enqueue_notification_activity('discovery:'||p_type||':'||p_id||':'||kind||':'
      ||md5(s->>'revision')||':'||who.id::text,kind,p_id,owner_id,who.id,
      jsonb_build_object('sourceType',p_type,'revision',s->>'revision','audience',s->>'audience'),
      now(),now()+case when p_type in ('live_stage','broadcast') then interval '10 minutes' else interval '24 hours' end);
  end loop;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.enqueue_notification_activity(p_event_key text, p_event_kind text, p_source_id text, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_recipient_user_id uuid, p_context jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_scheduled_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), p_expires_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_id uuid;
begin
  if p_recipient_user_id is null or p_actor_user_id=p_recipient_user_id then return null; end if;
  insert into public.notification_activity_events(event_key,event_kind,source_id,actor_user_id,recipient_user_id,context,scheduled_at,expires_at)
  values(p_event_key,p_event_kind,p_source_id,p_actor_user_id,p_recipient_user_id,coalesce(p_context,'{}'),p_scheduled_at,
    coalesce(p_expires_at,p_scheduled_at+interval '1 day'))
  on conflict(event_key) do nothing returning id into v_id;
  return v_id;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.live_notification_read_context(p_notification_id uuid, p_viewer uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if exists(select 1 from public.notifications n join public.notification_activity_events e
    on e.id=private.discovery_notification_uuid(n.source_id) and e.notification_id=n.id
    join public.watch_party_rooms r on r.party_id=case when e.context->>'sourceType'='broadcast'
      then (select coalesce(nullif(b.source_room_id,''),nullif(b.watch_party_room_id,'')) from public.room_broadcast_sessions b
        where b.id=private.discovery_notification_uuid(e.source_id)) else e.source_id end
    where n.id=p_notification_id and n.user_id=p_viewer and n.source_type='notification_activity'
      and n.notification_type in ('followed_creator_live','circle_friend_live') and r.discovery_paused
      and not exists(select 1 from private.creator_event_broadcast_preparations p where p.party_id=r.party_id))
    then return '{}'; end if;
  return private.live_notification_read_context_pre_listing_pause(p_notification_id,p_viewer);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.live_notification_read_context_pre_listing_pause(p_notification_id uuid, p_viewer uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  result:=private.live_notification_read_context_pre_hint_receipts(p_notification_id,p_viewer);
  if result->>'allowed'='true' and exists(select 1 from public.notifications n where n.id=p_notification_id
      and n.user_id=p_viewer and n.notification_type='live_room_member_joined')
    and not exists(select 1 from private.room_attendance_hint_receipts s
      join public.notification_activity_events e on e.id=s.event_id and e.notification_id=s.notification_id
      where s.notification_id=p_notification_id and s.recipient_user_id=p_viewer
        and e.recipient_user_id=p_viewer and e.actor_user_id=s.actor_user_id and e.source_id=s.party_id
        and e.context->>'generation'=s.generation::text and e.context->>'hostId'=s.host_user_id::text)
    then return '{}'; end if;
  return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.live_notification_visible(p_notification_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select public.whole_app_exact_current_session_authority_internal()
    and coalesce((private.live_notification_read_context(p_notification_id,auth.uid())->>'allowed')::boolean,false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.notification_activity_token_current(p_token user_push_tokens, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p_token.user_id=p_user_id and p_token.provider='expo' and p_token.enabled
    and p_token.revoked_at is null and p_token.ownership_state='ACCOUNT_BOUND'
    and exists(select 1 from public.wave1_push_installation_ownership o
      where o.platform=p_token.platform and o.install_id=p_token.install_id
        and o.user_id=p_user_id and o.account_id=p_user_id and o.revoked_at is null
        and o.ownership_state='ACCOUNT_BOUND' and o.session_generation=p_token.session_generation)
    and exists(select 1 from auth.sessions s where s.id::text=p_token.session_generation and s.user_id=p_user_id
      and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>now()));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.notification_display_label(p_value text, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select nullif(btrim(left(regexp_replace(translate(coalesce(p_value,''),
    U&'\200B\200C\200D\200E\200F\202A\202B\202C\202D\202E\2066\2067\2068\2069\FEFF',''),
    '[[:cntrl:]]',' ','g'),least(greatest(p_limit,1),160))),'');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.notification_subject_label(p_value text, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select nullif(left(btrim(regexp_replace(translate(coalesce(p_value,''),
   chr(8234)||chr(8235)||chr(8236)||chr(8237)||chr(8238)||chr(8294)||chr(8295)||chr(8296)||chr(8297),''),
   '[[:cntrl:][:space:]]+',' ','g')),greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,120),240))),'');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.resolve_seat_notification_activity_before_auctions(p_event notification_activity_events)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare s jsonb:=private.seat_notification_source(p_event.event_kind,private.seat_notification_uuid(p_event.source_id));
begin
  if not coalesce((s->>'eligible')::boolean,false)
    or s->>'actor' is distinct from p_event.actor_user_id::text
    or s->>'recipient' is distinct from p_event.recipient_user_id::text
    or s->>'revision' is distinct from p_event.context->>'revision'
    or s->>'offerId' is distinct from p_event.context->>'offerId'
    then return '{"eligible":false}'; end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('eligible',true,'category',case when s->>'state'='requested'
    then 'creator_money_sale' else 'creator_money_purchase' end,'notification_type',p_event.event_kind,
    'title',case s->>'state' when 'requested' then 'Live Stage seat requested' when 'approved' then 'Live Stage seat approved'
      else 'Live Stage seat request not approved' end,
    'body',case s->>'state' when 'requested' then 'A viewer requested a speaking seat. Open the Stage to review it.'
      when 'approved' then 'The host approved your current speaking seat. Open the Stage to check your current role.'
      else 'The host did not approve this speaking-seat request. Your pass remains eligibility only.' end,
    'target_route','/watch-party/live-stage/[partyId]','target_entity_id',s->>'partyId',
    'target_context','{}'::jsonb,'preference_key','seat_activity_enabled');
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.resolve_social_notification_pre_live_room_join(p_event notification_activity_events)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare plan jsonb; actor_name text; handle text; subject_label text; copy_body text;
begin
 plan:=private.resolve_social_notification_before_subject_context(p_event);
 if plan->>'eligible' is distinct from 'true' then return plan; end if;
 if exists(select 1 from public.account_deletion_requests where user_id::text=p_event.actor_user_id::text
   and status in ('scheduled','completed')) then return '{"eligible":false}'; end if;
 select private.notification_subject_label(display_name,80),private.notification_subject_label(username,60)
 into actor_name,handle from public.user_profiles where user_id=p_event.actor_user_id::text
   and profile_access_visibility='public' and not public.is_platform_owner_user(user_id);
 if actor_name is null then actor_name:=case when handle is not null then '@'||handle else 'Member unavailable' end;
 elsif handle is not null and lower(actor_name)<>lower(handle) and lower(actor_name)<>lower('@'||handle)
   then actor_name:=actor_name||' (@'||handle||')'; end if;
 if p_event.event_kind='content_shared' then
   select private.notification_subject_label(title,160) into subject_label from public.titles
    where id=private.social_notification_uuid(plan->>'target_entity_id');
 elsif p_event.event_kind in ('video_comment','video_reply') then
   select private.notification_subject_label(title,160) into subject_label from public.videos
    where id=private.social_notification_uuid(plan->>'target_entity_id');
 end if;
 copy_body:=case p_event.event_kind
 when 'social_follow' then actor_name||' followed your Platform.'
 when 'social_follow_request' then actor_name||' requested to follow your Platform.'
 when 'social_follow_accepted' then actor_name||' accepted your follow request.'
 when 'circle_request' then actor_name||' sent you a Chi''lly Circle request.'
 when 'circle_accepted' then actor_name||' accepted your Chi''lly Circle request.'
 when 'circle_added' then actor_name||' added you to their Chi''lly Circle.'
 when 'content_shared' then actor_name||' shared '||coalesce(subject_label,'an untitled title')||'.'
 when 'circle_post' then actor_name||' posted a Chi''lly Circle update.'
 when 'profile_post_liked' then actor_name||' liked your profile post.'
 when 'profile_comment' then actor_name||' commented on your profile post.'
 when 'profile_reply' then actor_name||' replied to your profile comment.'
 when 'video_comment' then actor_name||' commented on '||coalesce(subject_label,'your video')||'.'
 when 'video_reply' then actor_name||' replied to your comment on '||coalesce(subject_label,'a video')||'.'
 when 'chat_message' then actor_name||' sent you a Chi''lly Chat message.'
 else plan->>'body' end;
 return plan||jsonb_build_object('body',copy_body,'target_context',coalesce(plan->'target_context','{}'::jsonb)
   ||jsonb_build_object('display_context',jsonb_build_object('version',1,'actor_id',p_event.actor_user_id,
    'actor_display_name',actor_name,'target_id',plan->>'target_entity_id','subject_title',subject_label)));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.resolve_view_notification_activity(p_event notification_activity_events)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_count integer; v_kind text; v_day date;
begin
  if p_event.event_kind not in ('video_view_summary','live_view_summary') or p_event.actor_user_id is not null then
    return '{"eligible":false}'::jsonb; end if;
  v_kind:=case when p_event.event_kind='video_view_summary' then 'video' else 'live' end;
  v_day:=(p_event.context->>'viewDay')::date;
  if v_day::text<>p_event.source_id or p_event.context->>'viewKind'<>v_kind or v_day>=(now() at time zone 'UTC')::date
    then return '{"eligible":false}'::jsonb; end if;
  select count(distinct q.viewer_user_id)::integer into v_count from public.notification_qualified_views q
    where q.creator_user_id=p_event.recipient_user_id and q.view_kind=v_kind and q.view_day=v_day
      and not public.is_account_access_restricted(q.viewer_user_id::text)
      and not public.has_channel_audience_block_between(q.creator_user_id::text,q.viewer_user_id::text)
      and ((v_kind='video' and exists(select 1 from public.videos v where v.id::text=q.source_id
        and v.owner_id=q.creator_user_id and v.quarantined_at is null and v.moderation_status in ('clean','reported')))
        or (v_kind='live' and (exists(select 1 from public.watch_party_rooms r where r.party_id=q.source_id
          and r.host_user_id=q.creator_user_id and r.room_type='live')
          or exists(select 1 from public.spectator_hls_playback_records r where 'hls:'||r.id::text=q.source_id
            and coalesce(nullif(r.channel_user_id,''),nullif(r.host_user_id,''))=q.creator_user_id::text
            and r.playback_status in ('live','ended') and r.visibility in ('public','circle')))));
  if v_count=0 then return '{"eligible":false}'::jsonb; end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('eligible',true,'category','view_summary','notification_type',p_event.event_kind,
    'title',case when v_kind='video' then 'Your video views' else 'Your live views' end,
    'body',v_count::text||case when v_count=1 then ' viewer watched your ' else ' viewers watched your ' end||
      case when v_kind='video' then 'videos on ' else 'live content on ' end||v_day::text||'.',
    'target_route','/channel-studio','target_entity_id',null,
    'target_context',jsonb_build_object('viewDay',v_day,'viewerCount',v_count,'viewKind',v_kind),
    'preference_key','view_summary_enabled');
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.room_notification_owner_opt_in(p_party_id text, p_host uuid, p_viewer uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(select 1 from public.watch_party_rooms r where r.party_id=p_party_id and r.host_user_id=p_host
    and public.is_platform_owner_user(p_host::text) and private.room_host_discovery_consented(r)
    and p_viewer is not null and not public.is_account_access_restricted(p_viewer::text)
    and not public.has_channel_audience_block_between(p_host::text,p_viewer::text)
    and (r.discovery_visibility='public' or (r.discovery_visibility='circle'
      and public.is_active_chilly_circle_member(p_host::text,p_viewer::text)))
    and ((r.room_type='title' and private.party_room_publication_current(r.party_id))
      or (r.room_type='live' and private.live_stage_publication_current(r.party_id))));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sandbox_cashout_current_user()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if public.whole_app_exact_current_session_authority_internal() is distinct from true
 or public.resolve_sandbox_monetization_tester() is distinct from true then raise exception 'sandbox_current_tester_required'; end if;
 return auth.uid();
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sandbox_cashout_enabled()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from private.sandbox_cashout_control where singleton and enabled)
 and not exists(select 1 from unnest(array['live_money_enabled','payouts_enabled','cashout_enabled']) k
 where not exists(select 1 from public.platform_money_kill_switches s where s.key=k and s.state='off'))
 and not exists(select 1 from unnest(array['stripe_connect_enabled','creator_monetization_enabled','provider_webhooks_enabled']) k
 where not exists(select 1 from public.platform_money_kill_switches s where s.key=k and s.state='sandbox_only'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sandbox_cashout_merch_source(p_id uuid, p_qualification uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare o public.merch_orders; p public.stripe_merch_events; q private.sandbox_cashout_qualifications;
 b private.commerce_tax_checkout_bindings; net bigint; h text;
begin
 select * into o from public.merch_orders where id=p_id;
 select * into q from private.sandbox_cashout_qualifications where id=p_qualification;
 select * into b from private.commerce_tax_checkout_bindings where feature='physical_merch' and identity_id=p_id;
 if o.id is null or q.id is null or o.creator_id is distinct from q.creator_id or o.buyer_id is null or o.buyer_id=o.creator_id
  or o.provider is distinct from 'stripe_physical_goods' or o.environment is distinct from 'sandbox' or o.currency is distinct from 'usd'
  or o.payment_status is distinct from 'paid' or o.order_status not in ('paid','fulfilled') or o.paid_at is null
  or o.amount_total_minor is null or o.amount_total_minor<=0 or o.digital_access_grant_id is not null
  or coalesce(o.refunded_amount_minor,0)<>0 or o.refunded_at is not null or o.canceled_at is not null
  or o.fulfillment_status in ('canceled','blocked','returned')
  or b.identity_id is null or b.environment is distinct from 'sandbox' or b.product_id is distinct from o.product_id::text
  or b.account_id is distinct from q.platform_account_id
  or exists(select 1 from public.stripe_merch_events t where t.linked_order_id=o.id and t.environment='sandbox'
   and t.status='processed' and t.event_type in ('charge.refunded','charge.dispute.created'))
 then return null; end if;
 -- The canonical signed-webhook processor proves the order identity, amount,
 -- currency and test mode. The checkout's immutable tax-account binding came
 -- before provider dispatch and the Edge path verified that account with GET.
 select * into p from public.stripe_merch_events where linked_order_id=o.id and provider='stripe'
  and environment='sandbox' and status='processed' and processed_at is not null
  and raw_event_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and metadata->>'processing_reason'='payment_confirmed'
  and ((event_type in ('checkout.session.completed','checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded') and object_id=o.stripe_checkout_session_id)
   or (event_type='payment_intent.succeeded' and object_id=o.stripe_payment_intent_id))
  order by processed_at,id limit 1;
 if p.id is null then return null; end if;
 net:=o.amount_total_minor::bigint-((o.amount_total_minor::bigint*q.simulated_tax_bps+9999)/10000)
  -((o.amount_total_minor::bigint*q.simulated_platform_bps+9999)/10000)
  -((o.amount_total_minor::bigint*q.simulated_provider_bps+9999)/10000)-q.simulated_provider_fixed_minor;
 if net<=0 or net>2147483647 then return null; end if;
 -- Shipping progress does not invalidate unchanged payment economics. Refund,
 -- dispute, ownership, mode, amount or payment-identity changes do invalidate.
 h:=md5(jsonb_build_object('order',o.id,'buyer',o.buyer_id,'creator',o.creator_id,'product',o.product_id,
  'environment',o.environment,'currency',o.currency,'amount',o.amount_total_minor,'paidAt',o.paid_at,
  'checkout',o.stripe_checkout_session_id,'paymentIntent',o.stripe_payment_intent_id,'charge',o.stripe_charge_id,
  'receipt',p.id,'receiptHash',p.raw_event_hash,'binding',to_jsonb(b))::text);
 return jsonb_build_object('netMinor',net,'sourceHash',h);
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sandbox_cashout_recovery_current(p_execution uuid, p_stage text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select a.id from private.sandbox_cashout_recovery_authorities a
 join private.sandbox_cashout_executions e on e.id=a.execution_id
 join private.sandbox_cashout_qualifications q on q.id=e.qualification_id
 where e.id=p_execution and a.stage=p_stage and a.environment='test' and a.currency='usd'
 and a.transfer_id=e.transfer_id and a.account_id=q.account_id and a.platform_account_id=q.platform_account_id
 and a.original_transfer_minor=e.bank_minor and a.prior_returned_minor=0 and a.recoverable_minor=e.bank_minor
 and a.verified_at<=clock_timestamp() and a.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
 and not exists(select 1 from private.sandbox_cashout_recovery_revocations r where r.authority_id=a.id)
 order by a.verified_at desc,a.id desc limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sandbox_cashout_subject_current(p_user uuid, p_session uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from auth.users u join auth.sessions s on s.user_id=u.id
   where u.id=p_user and s.id=p_session and u.deleted_at is null and u.email_confirmed_at is not null
   and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>clock_timestamp()))
 and not public.is_account_access_restricted(p_user::text)
 and (public.platform_subject_has_role_internal(p_user::text,array['owner','operator'])
 or exists(select 1 from public.beta_access_memberships b where b.user_id=p_user::text and b.access_status='active')
 or exists(select 1 from public.sandbox_monetization_testers t where t.user_id=p_user::text and t.status='active'
   and (t.expires_at is null or t.expires_at>clock_timestamp())));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sandbox_cashout_summary(p_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('requestId',e.id,'status',e.phase,'environment','test','financialAuthority',false,
 'grossMinor',e.gross_minor,'appFeeMinor',e.app_fee_minor,'bankMinor',e.bank_minor,
 'expectedProviderFeeMinor',e.expected_provider_fee_minor,'observedProviderFeeMinor',null,
 'feeStatus','simulated_not_actual','earningsBasis','sandbox_fixture_deductions_not_actual_fees',
 'settlementPolicyVersion',q.settlement_policy_version,'bankPaid',false,'providerTestPaid',e.phase='paid',
 'returnedToPlatform',e.phase='returned','canRetry',false,'canCancel',e.phase in ('prepared','funded'),
 'fundingReturnHeld',e.phase in ('funding_return_pending','funding_return_unknown'),
 'sourceHeld',e.source_hold,
 'qualificationStatus',case when q.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() or exists(select 1 from private.sandbox_cashout_revocations where qualification_id=q.id) then 'expired_or_revoked' else 'current' end,
 'recoveryAuthorityRequired',e.phase in ('return_confirmed','funding_return_pending')
  and (q.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() or exists(select 1 from private.sandbox_cashout_revocations where qualification_id=q.id))
  and private.sandbox_cashout_recovery_current(e.id,case when e.phase='return_confirmed' then 'reversal' else 'funding_return' end) is null,
 'ownerAction',case when e.phase in ('return_confirmed','funding_return_pending')
  and (q.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() or exists(select 1 from private.sandbox_cashout_revocations where qualification_id=q.id))
  and private.sandbox_cashout_recovery_current(e.id,case when e.phase='return_confirmed' then 'reversal' else 'funding_return' end) is null
  then 'sandbox_recovery_authority_required'
  when e.source_hold then 'sandbox_source_reconciliation_required'
  when e.phase in ('prepared','funded') and (q.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() or exists(select 1 from private.sandbox_cashout_revocations where qualification_id=q.id))
  then 'sandbox_cashout_provider_qualification_required' else null end)
 from private.sandbox_cashout_executions e join private.sandbox_cashout_qualifications q on q.id=e.qualification_id where e.id=p_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.social_notification_accounts_allowed(p_actor uuid, p_recipient uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p_actor is not null and p_recipient is not null and p_actor <> p_recipient
    and exists(select 1 from auth.users where id=p_actor)
    and exists(select 1 from auth.users where id=p_recipient)
    and not public.is_account_access_restricted(p_actor::text)
    and not public.is_account_access_restricted(p_recipient::text)
    and not public.has_channel_audience_block_between(p_actor::text,p_recipient::text);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.social_notification_profile_allowed(p_owner text, p_recipient uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.user_profiles profile
    where profile.user_id=p_owner
      and exists(select 1 from auth.users where id::text=p_owner)
      and not public.is_account_access_restricted(p_owner)
      and not public.is_account_access_restricted(p_recipient::text)
      and not public.has_channel_audience_block_between(p_owner,p_recipient::text)
      and (
        p_owner=p_recipient::text
        or profile.profile_access_visibility='public'
        or (profile.profile_access_visibility='private'
          and public.is_active_chilly_circle_member(p_owner,p_recipient::text))
        or (profile.profile_access_visibility in ('private','subscriber_only') and (
          exists(select 1 from public.channel_subscribers subscriber
            where subscriber.channel_user_id=p_owner and subscriber.subscriber_user_id=p_recipient::text
              and subscriber.status in ('active','grace_period')
              and (subscriber.expires_at is null or subscriber.expires_at>now()))
          or exists(select 1 from public.creator_channel_subscriptions subscription
            where subscription.creator_id::text=p_owner and subscription.subscriber_id=p_recipient
              and subscription.status in ('active','trialing','grace_period','cancel_pending')
              and subscription.revoked_at is null and subscription.expired_at is null
              and (subscription.current_period_end is null or subscription.current_period_end>now()))
        ))
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.spectator_notification_view_owner(p_record_id uuid, p_viewer uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_record public.spectator_hls_playback_records; v_session public.room_broadcast_sessions; v_owner text;
begin
  if p_viewer is null or p_viewer is distinct from auth.uid() then return null; end if;
  select * into v_record from public.spectator_hls_playback_records where id=p_record_id;
  if not found or v_record.playback_status<>'live' or not v_record.is_spectator_playback_enabled
    or v_record.requires_premium or v_record.requires_ticket or nullif(v_record.playlist_path,'') is null
    or v_record.rights_status not in ('creator_owned','chillywood_original','licensed_for_public_stream') then return null; end if;
  select * into v_session from public.room_broadcast_sessions where id=v_record.broadcast_session_id;
  if not found or v_session.ended_at is not null
    or v_session.broadcast_status in ('ended','failed_later','cancelled','stopping_later')
    or v_session.egress_status in ('stopped_later','failed_later')
    or not (v_session.broadcast_status='active_later' or v_session.egress_status='active_later')
    or v_record.host_user_id is distinct from v_session.host_user_id
    or coalesce(nullif(v_record.channel_user_id,''),v_record.host_user_id) is distinct from
       coalesce(nullif(v_session.channel_user_id,''),v_session.host_user_id)
    or v_record.source_room_id is distinct from coalesce(nullif(v_session.source_room_id,''),
       nullif(v_session.watch_party_room_id,''),nullif(v_session.creator_event_id,''))
    or v_record.watch_party_room_id is distinct from v_session.watch_party_room_id
    or v_record.creator_event_id is distinct from v_session.creator_event_id
    or not v_session.is_spectator_playback_enabled or v_session.requires_premium or v_session.requires_ticket
    or v_session.rights_status not in ('creator_owned','chillywood_original','licensed_for_public_stream')
    or nullif(v_session.hls_playback_url,'') is null then return null; end if;
  if v_record.visibility='public' and v_record.access_type='public_free' and v_record.is_publicly_watchable
    and v_session.access_type='public_free' and v_session.is_publicly_watchable
    and v_session.playback_url_status='public_safe_available' and v_session.metadata->>'d7f_public_safe_approved'='true'
  then null;
  elsif v_record.visibility='circle' and v_record.access_type='circle' and not v_record.is_publicly_watchable
    and v_session.access_type='circle' and not v_session.is_publicly_watchable
    and v_session.playback_url_status='circle_safe_available' and v_session.metadata->>'circle_spectator_approved'='true'
    and public.can_read_circle_spectator_playback_record(p_record_id,p_viewer::text)
  then null;
  else return null; end if;
  v_owner:=coalesce(nullif(v_record.channel_user_id,''),nullif(v_record.host_user_id,''));
  if v_owner is null or v_owner !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    or v_owner=p_viewer::text or public.is_account_access_restricted(v_owner)
    or public.is_account_access_restricted(p_viewer::text)
    or public.has_channel_audience_block_between(v_owner,p_viewer::text) then return null; end if;
  -- Bind the playback to its still-current, authoritative live source.
  if v_session.source_type in ('watch_party_room','live_stage_room') then
    if not exists(select 1 from public.watch_party_rooms r
      where r.party_id=v_record.source_room_id and r.is_active
        and r.host_user_id::text=v_session.host_user_id) then return null; end if;
  elsif v_session.source_type='creator_event' then
    if not exists(select 1 from public.creator_events e
      where e.id::text=v_session.creator_event_id and e.host_user_id=v_session.host_user_id
        and e.status='live_now' and (e.ends_at is null or e.ends_at>now())) then return null; end if;
  else return null; end if;
  return v_owner::uuid;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authorize_notification_activity_worker(p_token text)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_notification_activity_batch(p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  with obsolete as (
    select q.generation,q.publication_hash,q.actor_user_id
    from private.live_room_join_qualifications q
    left join public.watch_party_rooms r on r.party_id=q.party_id
    left join private.party_room_discovery_publications p on p.party_id=q.party_id
    left join auth.users u on u.id=q.actor_user_id
    where u.id is null or u.raw_app_meta_data->>'accountDeidentified'='true'
      or r.party_id is null or not r.is_active or r.notification_join_generation<>q.generation
      or md5(jsonb_build_array(p.publication_id,p.started_at,p.retired_at)::text)<>q.publication_hash
      or p.retired_at is not null
    order by q.qualified_at,q.generation,q.publication_hash,q.actor_user_id
    limit 100 for update of q skip locked
  ) delete from private.live_room_join_qualifications q using obsolete o
    where (q.generation,q.publication_hash,q.actor_user_id)=(o.generation,o.publication_hash,o.actor_user_id);
  return query select * from public.claim_notification_activity_batch_pre_join_retirement(p_limit);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_sandbox_creator_cashout_execution(p_request_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid:=private.sandbox_cashout_current_user();
begin
 if not exists(select 1 from private.sandbox_cashout_executions where id=p_request_id and creator_id=u) then raise exception 'sandbox_cashout_not_found'; end if;
 return private.sandbox_cashout_summary(p_request_id);
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_my_sandbox_creator_cashout_executions()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid:=private.sandbox_cashout_current_user(); r jsonb;
begin
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(private.sandbox_cashout_summary(e.id) order by e.created_at desc),'[]') into r
 from(select id,created_at from private.sandbox_cashout_executions where creator_id=u order by created_at desc,id desc limit 20)e;
 return r;
end; $function$
